The only positive aspect is that ACS sends SMS notifications—both via Viber and regular SMS—when your package arrives at their facility. This part works reliably.

On Saturday, I finally received a response stating: “Οι παραγγελίες για παραλαβή από κατάστημα (pick up) χρειάζονται έως και 3 εργάσιμες ημέρες για να ολοκληρωθούν.” This was surprising, given that all items were listed as in stock and the order was placed early in the day.

I waited again all day Monday with no update.

[{"Name":"Green Hill Zone Speedrun","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjXwB6-mnysQ0fxQ4kiNSgjNLzhjp_P3eMOD3iBq-TYz4rs-MS4=s120-c-rp-mo-ba12-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"I was thrilled to discover LosHotWheels - a diecast collector’s paradise. I was looking for the latest Mini GTs, and they had exactly what I needed in stock, priced lower than what they cost overseas.

Their massive walls of Hot Wheels are mind-blowing to see, and all at fair prices. I quickly built up a stack of older models that I was missing (from 2019 - 2023) and had a lot of fun browsing the shelves and pegs.

They have Hot Wheels mainlines (both short and long cards), Silver series, premiums and even RLC. Additionally, they stock Mini GT, Jada, Kaido House and more, all reasonably priced and beautifully arranged. They have imported models that no other shop in Cyprus has. There are also some action figures including McFarlane DC Multiverse and Masters of the Universe.

I especially appreciate that LosHotWheels stock so many older models so I can fill holes in my collection, but they also have all the new Silvers and Premiums and by buying them here you know they're straight from the case and handled carefully. They even offered to package my cars in a box at checkout, showing they understand collectors’ needs (or our OCD, let's be honest).

You can buy entire sealed cases of the new releases here to avoid having to spend months hunting for the short-packed castings.

We first visited this store in October last year and were very satisfied with our experience. The staff was welcoming, friendly, and helpful, which made us want to come back.

However, during our recent visit, the experience was completely different.
We first asked a young man in the plant section, who was sitting in front of a computer, for advice. He did not know the answer, responded in a cold manner without trying to help further, and then went back to what seemed to be a video on his phone. This behavior felt very unprofessional.

At the checkout, we were then served by Liliana K. No greeting at all, and our items were handled carelessly, to the point that the contents of one of our plants spilled.

When it was time to pay, we realized our bank account was not sufficiently funded. We asked to wait a few minutes, which clearly annoyed her. The interaction became unpleasant and we felt almost scolded.
